title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：metaphor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 metaphor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the writer ① used the metaphor that no reader in the study would have recorded, and he said the using was the whole of the month. The ② metaphor, meaning the image itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a metaphor, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ metaphor in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ metaphor at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A metaphor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the writer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the metaphor was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the image. The ⑥ metaphor, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; metaphor, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both an image and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ metaphor had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ metaphor of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of recording; metaphor, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ metaphor I remember is the image recorded in the manuscript, which closed in 1959 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ metaphor, my mother said in 1961, is the only image that improves by being recorded; every metaphor, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like an image. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 隐喻；比喻（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 隐喻；比喻（指那个隐喻本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the metaphor 用这一个隐喻
D. n. 隐喻；比喻（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 隐喻之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的隐喻之事）
F. n. 隐喻；比喻（指手稿里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 隐喻、深意（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 深意（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the metaphor that no reader in the study would have recorded
The metaphor, meaning the image itself and not the page
the metaphor at the far shelf
the metaphor was the whole of the matter
the metaphor had become a line in a manuscript
The metaphor of the whole thing
A metaphor, my mother said in 1961

answers.why: use the metaphor 意为“用这一个隐喻”，1952 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记载的一个隐喻做了一遍。
metaphor 意为“隐喻；比喻”，指那个隐喻本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
metaphor 意为“隐喻；比喻”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
metaphor 意为“隐喻；比喻”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
metaphor 意为“隐喻、深意”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个深意就是那件事的全部。
metaphor 意为“深意”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个隐喻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
metaphor 意为“隐喻；比喻”，指手稿里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1957 年这一个成了手稿里的一行。
metaphor 意为“隐喻之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的隐喻之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记载。
metaphor 意为“隐喻；比喻”，我记得的是手稿里记载过的那一个，1959 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
metaphor 为抽象总称，母亲 1961 年说，隐喻是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的隐喻。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年那位写作者用了书斋里没有一位读者肯记载的一个隐喻，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（use the metaphor）
那个隐喻，指的是那个隐喻本身而不是薄薄的书页，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。（metaphor）
那处书斋里每一个隐喻旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。（metaphor）
最远那层书架那个隐喻，指的是他们留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（metaphor）
叔叔说这个深意就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个隐喻。（metaphor）
1961 年母亲说，隐喻是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的隐喻。（metaphor）
